indications: Benzonatate USP is indicated for the symptomatic relief of cough.
contraindications:
Adults and Children over 10 years of age: Usual dose is one 100 mg, 150 mg or 200 mg capsule three times a day as needed for cough. If necessary to control cough, up to 600 mg daily in three divided doses may be given. 
 
  Benzonatate should be swallowed whole. Benzonatate capsules are not to be broken, chewed, dissolved, cut or crushed.
warningsAndPrecautions:
Benzonatate Capsules USP, 200 mg: Yellow soft gelatin capsules, imprinted “106”, available in bottles of 15's (NDC 51655-776-54) and 30’s (NDC 51655-776-52)
                  Store at 20°C to 25° C (68°F to 77°F). [See USP Controlled Room Temperature]. 
  PROTECT FROM LIGHT.
